findings.title: Attributed delegated cooperative repair
findings.claim: The supplied HFT before-reading, "A powerful ruler offers to build a wall," changes into its supplied after-reading, "A steward of received capacity organizes communal force to repair a specific breach."
findings.mechanism: مَكَّنِّي carries received capacity and meets رَبِّي as its agent; أَعِينُونِي and قُوَّةٍ turn that capacity into organized contribution; رَدْمًا, placed between the two endpoints, gives the contribution a breach-closing product.
findings.reader_payoff: Authority becomes legible as stewardship that gathers distributed force and converts it into repair while keeping the speaker as maker.
findings.containment: This is attributed HFT evidence with exact focus coordinates. The ordinary wall/barrier scene, the speaker's agency, and the human contribution remain recoverable; no wider doctrine of rule or literal cable image is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact to 18:95 and its carriers/triggers are present, but the source is legacy_unbound and therefore retained as attributed evidence.
